EXPLORER Standard Features
Mechanical Exterior
3.5L Ti-VCT V6 engine Bi-functional projector-beam halogen headlamps
6-speed SelectShift Automatic™ transmission Dual chrome exhaust tips
4-wheel disc Anti-Lock Brake System (ABS) LED taillamps
18.6-gallon fuel tank Power sideview mirrors with integrated blind spot mirrors
Easy Fuel® capless fuel filler and manual fold-away design
Electric power-assisted steering Privacy glass (rear doors, rear quarter windows
and liftgate window)
Front-wheel drive (FWD)
Rear spoiler
Hill start assist
Remote Keyless Entry System with 2 integrated keyhead
Independent front and rear suspension
transmitter remotes
Traction control
Roof-mounted antenna
Trailer sway control
Windshield wipers – Front: speed-sensitive, variable-intermittent
with washer; rear: 2-speed with washer
Seating
1st-row bucket seats Safety & Security
2nd-row 60/40 split fold-flat seat Personal Safety System™ for driver and front passenger
3rd-row 50/50 split fold-flat seat includes dual-stage front airbags,1 safety belt pretensioners,
safety belt energy-management retractors, safety belt usage
Interior sensors, driver’s seat position sensor, crash severity sensor,
restraint control module and Front-Passenger Sensing System
1st-, 2nd- and 3rd-row dome/map lights
AdvanceTrac® with RSC® (Roll Stability Control™)
1st- and 2nd-row carpeted floor mats
and Curve Control
1st- and 2nd-row scuff plates with embossed Explorer logo
Autolock
1st-row center console with armrest and storage
Battery saver with headlamps-off delay
Accessory delay for power features
Belt-Minder® front safety belt reminder
Adjustable driver and front-passenger sun visors
Child-safety rear door locks
with covered vanity mirrors
Front height-adjustable shoulder safety belts
Air conditioning with auxiliary rear controls
Front-seat side airbags1
Cabin air filter
Illuminated Entry System
Cargo area hooks
LATCH – Lower Anchors and Tether Anchors for Children
Four 12-volt powerpoints (2 in 1st row, 1 in 2nd row
(2 in rear outboard seating positions)
and 1 in rear cargo area)
MyKey®
Front-passenger (1) and B-pillar (2) assist handles
Safety Canopy® System with side-curtain airbags1
Load floor tie-down hooks
and rollover sensor
Overhead console with sunglasses holder
SecuriLock® Passive Anti-Theft System
Power door locks
SOS Post-Crash Alert System™ unlocks doors, flashes
Power windows hazard lights and sounds horn after airbag deployment
Rear-window defroster or safety belt pretensioner activation in certain collisions2
Steering wheel-mounted cruise, audio, and 5-way Tire Pressure Monitoring System (excludes spare)
MyFord™ controls (2)
Tilt/telescoping steering column
Horsepower, Torque & EPA-Estimated Fuel Economy
3.5L Ti-VCT V6 Engine Horsepower: 290 @ 6,500 rpm Torque (lb.-ft.): 255 @ 4,000 rpm
6-speed SelectShift Automatic
FWD 18 city/25 hwy/20 combined mpg
4WD 17 city/23 hwy/19 combined mpg
2.0L EcoBoost™ I-4 Engine Horsepower: 240 @ 5,500 rpm3 Torque: 270 @ 3,000 rpm3
6-speed automatic 20 city/28 hwy/23 combined mpg
1 Always wear your safety belt and secure children in the rear seat. 2SOS hardware may become damaged or the battery may lose power in a crash,
which could prevent operation. Not all crashes will activate an airbag or safety belt pretensioner. 3Figures achieved using premium unleaded gasoline.
Comparisons based on 2011 competitive models (class is Large Utilities), publicly available information and Ford certification data at time of release.
Some features discussed may be optional. Vehicles shown may contain optional equipment. Features shown may be offered only in combination
with other options or subject to additional ordering requirements or limitations. Dimensions shown may vary due to optional features and/or
production variability. Following release of the PDF, certain changes in standard equipment, options and the like, or product delays may have
occurred which would not be included in these pages. Your Ford Dealer is the best source for up-to-date information. Ford Division reserves the
right to change product specifications at any time without incurring obligations. 2012 EXPLORER ford.com
